valuationInputs.name: Beta
valuationInputs.reason: 8 steps, 15 Nov 2026. (1) Business: one business, the PickMe app, earning platform fees on rides and deliveries; a software platform whose demand is transport, so weighted half internet software, half transportation. (2) Damodaran's emerging-markets dataset (betaEmerg) could NOT be opened: his site is blocked by this run's network settings. Stand-ins from web-search extracts of his tables: Software (Internet) global unlevered, cash-corrected 1.34 (date not shown in the extract); Transportation US unlevered 0.71 (January 2026). 0.5 × 1.34 + 0.5 × 0.71 = 1.03. (3) Net cash (Rs 3.7bn at Sep 2026, against market value Rs 57bn), so debt to equity 0 and no relevering: 1.03. (4) Local 5-year betas: none exist; the share listed on 3 October 2024, so there are only about two years of prices. TradingView shows 1-year betas of 0.51 and 0.65 (ignored, as the brief says). (5) Higher of 1.03 and (no local figure) = 1.03. (6) Within 0.3–2. (7) Into the formula by scripts/reinvestment.py. Provisional: refresh in January 2027 with Damodaran's emerging-markets file, and use local 5-year betas once October 2029 gives five years of trading.

valuationInputs.name: Cost of equity
valuationInputs.reason: From scripts/reinvestment.py (15 Nov 2026): 8.24% + 1.03 × (4.2% + 6.08%) = 18.8%, ±1.5 points. Replaces the hand-set 17.5 / 16 / 15%.

valuationInputs.name: WACC
valuationInputs.reason: From scripts/reinvestment.py (15 Nov 2026): net cash Rs 3.68bn (Sep 2026), so debt weight 0% and WACC = cost of equity. Lease cost of debt 13.78% (no weight).

valuationInputs.name: Growth check
valuationInputs.value: Assumed 12% / 18% / 24% for seven years; supported −0.4% (reinvestment rate −0.2% × return on capital 203.7%, FY 2026). All three far above: kept because the platform is asset-light — growth costs (incentives, marketing, most engineering pay) run through profit, drivers own the vehicles and driver payables fund working capital, so revenue grew 49% with nil net reinvestment; profit kept × ROE gives 24.0%, above all three; and the DCF charges growth ÷ 40 / 60 / 80% return on capital in reinvestment every year.
valuationInputs.reason: From scripts/reinvestment.py on the FY 2026 figures recorded in this redo.

valuationInputs.name: Growth
valuationInputs.value: Bear 12% then 5% / Base 18% then 6% / Bull 24% then 7%
valuationInputs.reason: Seven years, then long-run. Revenue +38% and profit +49% in H1 FY2027; growth should slow as the app matures. Replaces 15 / 25 / 32% fading over ten years. Long-run below the 12.24% bond and WACC.

valuationInputs.name: Return on new capital
valuationInputs.reason: FY 2026 return on capital was 204% on a tiny capital base; set far lower so the DCF charges real reinvestment as the business matures.

valuationInputs.name: Cash after maintenance capex (start)
valuationInputs.value: Bear Rs 2.5bn / Base Rs 2.8bn / Bull Rs 3.0bn
valuationInputs.reason: Calculator FY 2026: operating cash 3.414 (interest in financing, nothing added back) − maintenance 0.887 / 0.799 / 0.799 = 2.53 / 2.62 / 2.62; base and bull lifted towards the last 12 months' operating cash of Rs 3.87bn.

valuationInputs.name: After-tax operating profit (start)
valuationInputs.value: Bear Rs 2.4bn / Base Rs 2.5bn / Bull Rs 2.6bn

valuationInputs.name: Maintenance capex basis
valuationInputs.reason: No company split. Depreciation and amortisation (PPE, own software, right-of-use); bear = average capex booked FY 2025–26. Software amortisation is a real cost of keeping the platform current, so it isn't taken off.

valuationInputs.name: R&D life
valuationInputs.reason: Development is already capitalised under LKAS 38 (Rs 0.81bn in FY 2026, 4-year life); research expensed isn't disclosed, so no adjustment and no double counting.

valuationInputs.name: ROE path
valuationInputs.reason: FY 2026 ROE 68.7%; fades as cash builds and competition matures. Sets the payout in the justified P/E (1 − growth ÷ ROE) and the long-run payout in the dividend model.

valuationInputs.name: EPS to March 2027 × P/E
valuationInputs.reason: H1 EPS Rs 4.24; H2 20% / 35% / 45% above last year's Rs 3.76. P/E = two-stage forward P/E justified at the cost of equity. Base 1% below the Rs 9.40 run-rate (Q2 × 4); bear 7% below.

valuationInputs.name: Dividend this year
valuationInputs.reason: 65% payout of the EPS estimate; then 80% in the long run.

valuationInputs.name: Methods used
valuationInputs.value: Whole-company DCF, justified P/E, dividend model
valuationInputs.reason: Asset-light cash generator; NAV, P/B and residual income not useful with such a small book value.

changeLog.basedOn: Annual Report 2025/26 and interims to 30 Jun and 30 Sep 2026 (CSE downloads), re-read in full
changeLog.summary: Requested from Telegram (/redo PKME full). Research record rebuilt from the downloaded reports: FY 2026 and FY 2025 reinvestment figures added (capex booked 0.96 / 0.82, of which own software development 0.81 / 0.68; depreciation and amortisation 0.80 / 0.61; working capital −0.16 / −0.03; no acquisitions; operating profit 3.05 / 1.60; tax 30.9% / 30.5%; equity; leases, cash and deposits, no borrowings; interest paid 0.047 / 0.042, financing section; dividends paid), H1 FY2027 cash flow, capex and net cash, a Q2 FY2027 quarter and a trailing-12-month period. Earlier figures, reportsRead and change log kept. Beta 1.03 (provisional: Damodaran's site was blocked, so global/US sector betas from web-search extracts; no local 5-year beta exists as the share listed in October 2024) gives cost of equity 18.8% (was 16% by hand); WACC the same (net cash). Capex-based supported growth −0.4% (asset-light, negative working capital); growth 12 / 18 / 24% kept with reasons, profit kept × ROE 24%. DCF now whole-company at WACC plus net cash: weighted 146.8 → 116.0; P/E now a justified P/E 144.5 → 89.2; dividend model 101.3 → 86.4. R&D already capitalised, no adjustment. Business tests re-scored 4 → 3 of 4: steady profit now fails (operating loss in 2021/22 shown in the annual report's chart, p. 42; no figure given). Still 'good'; category unchanged (watch list). Fair value Rs 131.0 → 97.2, buy Rs 111.4 → 82.6, strong buy Rs 98.3 → 72.9. No report problems.
